# Axial Skyrmions
- The definition differs by an addition of π compared to references [3, 12, 7] because it changes only one of the pion fields.
- The antiSkyrmion is obtained in those references by altering the sign of all three pion fields.
- The current paper's definition allows for a more natural comparison with monopoles.
- The profile function vanishes at a radius of s/2 from the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion center.

# Initial Conditions
- Skyrmions and antiSkyrmions are continuously patched together, with fields extending to the vacuum outside of their cores.
- In addition to simple ansatz (3.7) initial conditions, sophisticated conditions based on the rational map ansatz [11] were utilized.
- The rational map ansatz uses an axially symmetric charge n map for enhanced initial conditions.
